snippet.title: Vacant | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Driving to a new city you'd just moved into, you decided to get some rest on the way and stop at a roadside motel. Everything seems normal at first, until the host started acting strange...

I finally released my own horror game, couldn't have done this without y'all!

✨ Game Page: thewindyproject.itch.io/vacant

#gaming #horror #trailer #retro #horrorgame #gamedev
